review: final independent EME review after research freeze
domain: Passive 5.76–5.8 GHz Earth–Moon–Earth scattering and station practice
prior_followup_status: Partial; followup.md and followup-dispositions.json are retained unchanged

criteria.basis: Path and evidence definitions are clear; Senior and Siegel citation corrected using official NIST volume index and indexed scan record.

Independent reproduction of complete conditional 5.760GHz two-leg budget with correct ⟨B_TX B_RX⟩, separate antenna-temperature integration, reference planes and noise; target-band RCS/station calibration remain a declared empirical boundary.

Two conditional radial scattering profiles and point alternative are quantified, but no normalized angular specular/Hagfors-plus-diffuse scattering law or field/power interpretation is carried through.
Geometric support, projected measure, t50/t90/RMS, two beam-weighted power profiles and a historically anchored sensitivity are computed; 5.76GHz bistatic PDP remains unknown.

Joint surface delay/Doppler windows and factorized-marginal comparison use source-scaled conditional gradients and constructed orientation stress, with resolution convergence and a correct CW versus ranging falsifier; no target full-disk spectrum or joint capture is claimed.

Retarded-leg surface calculation and lead's station-separated retarded/simultaneous/geocenter synthetic comparisons expose applicable geometry errors. No actual site/epoch is specified and no actual ephemeris is claimed.
Primary local CPR .44/.45 and OC albedo .06 carried with footprint and cross-band limits; target-band projection remains unknown.
Correct centered Gaussian signal/noise coupling and aperture comparison exist; pointing offsets, station pattern/spillover, ground/sky and speckle correlation remain materially underquantified.
Two-end rain and operational context remain; conditional gas/cloud/low-elevation and joint site/weather-to-receiver case are still feasible and incomplete.
Several simple physical alternatives now have receiver-window consequences, but model implementation fidelity/cost/native integration comparison remains incomplete.

Primary 7.209GHz observed/predicted measurements, independent conditional link/noise arithmetic, disk geometry, and joint-grid convergence are reported with precise limits; calibrated whole-disc 5.76GHz observations remain unavailable.
Joint delay–Doppler dependence is quantified, but weather/pointing/polarization/noise/tracking/outage are not assembled into a compatible receiver-facing adverse state.

six_depth_dimensions.mechanisms_regimes_observables: Substantially covered; local X-band measurement, C-band conditional link, CW and ranging observables are separated.
six_depth_dimensions.source_discovery_original_evidence: Substantially covered with recorded access limits; full Sun et al. article and ITU body evidence checked; NIST identity verified, interior scan access not independently repeated.
six_depth_dimensions.alternatives_counterevidence: Improved but partial; projected/exponential/point alternatives and orientation stresses contrast, angular specular/diffuse model comparison remains.
six_depth_dimensions.quantitative_interpretation: Strong for stated conditional cases; units, measure, beam products, estimator definitions, reference planes, sensitivity and convergence declared.
six_depth_dimensions.executed_discriminators: Conditional budgets, Gaussian integrals, early-area comparison and 1000/2000-grid numerical convergence; no physical 5.76GHz observation.
six_depth_dimensions.decision_relevance: Delay/frequency window calculation and CW-vs-ranging discriminator are useful; combined atmospheric/pointing/noise and native fidelity choice remain incomplete.

Add a bounded pointing-offset and receiver sky/ground/spillover or spatial-correlation sensitivity to the centered Gaussian station model.
Join a compatible weather/pointing/polarization/noise condition to a delay-Doppler receiver-window statistic and state its failure observable.
